correctness.rationale: For total f:W→W, f^-1 preserves all Boolean operators; each r-ary term normalizes to a Boolean formula in f^{-t}x_i. Across every valuation, its value at a root depends only on the forward q-color trace, q=2^r. Any two of finitely many realized traces separate at a finite coordinate, so every subset of the trace set is term definable and |Clo_r|=2^{|T|}. An ultimately periodic rooted trace is realizable iff minimal period d divides some reachable cycle length and exact preperiod b≤H_f(d). Primitive rooted periods P_q(d)=Σ_{e|d} μ(e)q^{d/e}; summing exact b gives q^{H_f(d)}P_q(d). Hence E_f(q) formula, degree max_w(h_w+ell_w), leading coefficient distinct optimizing cycle lengths; r=0 gives 2 constants. Independent exhaustive all endofunctions on ≤4 worlds at q∈{1,2,3}: 864 trace comparisons match.
